lots.title: Supply and delivery of Softwood Timbers
lots.description: Bristol City Council (BSH/HRA) Lot 1 under the Joinery Timber Supplies Dynamic Purchasing System. Scope is the supply and delivery of softwood timbers for the Council's in-house joinery shop. The DPS is a framework (no minimum volume guarantee); individual orders are awarded through call-off competitions under this Lot.
requirements: Provider must have been admitted to the DPS for Lot 1 (Softwood Timbers) to be eligible to receive Call-Off invitations for softwood timber supply.
Provider must sign and return the DPS Agreement; until it is signed no Call-Off tenders may be bid.
Provider performance for Call-Off Contracts is governed by the General Terms & Conditions of the DPS Agreement and Schedule 7 Call-Off Terms & Conditions (separate document).
Provider must maintain Employer's Liability Insurance of £10,000,000 each and every claim.
Provider must maintain Public Liability Insurance of £5,000,000 each and every claim.
Provider must maintain Professional Indemnity Insurance of £2,500,000 each and every claim.
Provider must deliver Goods in a conscientious and timely manner with all due skill, care and diligence, applying Good Industry Practice.

Detailed product specification (species, grades, sizes, moisture content, certification) is not set out in the DPS Agreement and will be issued with each Call for Further Competition (Schedule 1 placeholder).

evidence_anchors.anchor_text: A DYNAMIC PURCHASING SYSTEM AGREEMENT FOR THE PROVISION OF JOINERY TIMBER SUPPLIES DIVIDED INTO 3 CATEGORIES
Lot 1 – Supply and delivery of Softwood Timbers
Lot 2 – Supply and delivery of Plywood and Door Blanks
Lot 3 – Supply and delivery of Hardwood and Hemlock

The Council placed a contract notice ... under the provision of a Dynamic Purchasing System ("DPS") established for the provision of Joinery Timber Supplies which divided into 3 Categories. Lot 1 – Supply and delivery of Softwood Timbers, Lot 2 – Supply and delivery of Plywood and Door Blanks, and Lot 3 –Supply and delivery of Hardwood and Hemlock.

On the basis of the Provider's Request to Participate, the Council admitted the Provider onto the DPS to be able to provide Goods, Services and/or Works in respect of the following Categories Lot 1 – [Supply and delivery of Softwood Timbers], Lot 2 – [Supply and delivery of Plywood and Door Blanks], and Lot 3 – [Supply and delivery of Hardwood and Hemlock].
The DPS is expected to run for an initial period of 4 (four) years, from 1st December 2022.
Employer's liability insurance | £10M each and every claim ... Public Liability Insurance | £5M each and every claim ... Professional indemnity Insurance | £2.5M each and every claim
the Provider acknowledges that, in entering into this Agreement, no form of exclusivity or volume guarantee has been granted by the Council

All admitted Providers shall be invited to submit a tender for each specific procurement under the DPS. Where the DPS has been divided into Lots, Providers which have been admitted to the relevant Lot corresponding to the specific procurement concerned will be invited to submit a Tender.
